messages:
emily: dropped a prototype for a permalink composer in the console. goal: let users craft deep links that include pane state, filters, and optionally a short share token. want quick design + routing sanity check

rafael: nice. quick Q: where does this live? a modal? a dropdown from the kebab?

emily: proposal: small floating composer anchored to the page header with a compact preview and copy button. also a 'copy with state' toggle

priya: routing implications: prefer query params for anything server-visible and hashes for transient UI. example permalink: /models/12?range=7d&env=prod#panel=metrics

chris: back-button behaviour concern: if composer toggles are pushed into history too aggressively, users hit a confusing back stack. only write history entries when user clicks 'Copy permalink' or clicks a pinned shortcut

kate: accessibility: composer must be reachable by keyboard, announce the generated URL, and put focus on the copy confirmation toast. include aria-live on the preview so screenreader users get feedback when the toggle changes

rafael: breadcrumbs note: when deep-linking to nested panes we should show a compact breadcrumb plus a context pill (e.g., "Models • metrics") so people know they didn't navigate to a different resource type

priya: route contract draft: keep stable base routes (/models/:id, /deploy/:id). query keys are allowed: range, env, filter. hash keys: panel, openPanel. composer should validate keys and warn if a param won't be preserved across environments

emily: UX copy for the composer toggle: 'Include UI state (tabs, open panels)'. short tooltip: 'Also include transient UI state such as open panels. May not persist across sessions.'

chris: QA checklist: permalink generation, paste into incognito => lands in same state, accessibility announcement, back-button after opening permalink, breadcrumb + context pill correctness

kate: add tests for screenreader announcing the preview and for focus return after copying. also ensure keyboard order: header -> composer -> main content

ui-bot: prototype added: https://figma.redwood/permalink-composer-v1 (comments enabled)

emily: thanks — i'll update the Figma with route examples and wire the QA items into the PR template. will also file a tiny RFC for the query/hash contract.
